description: Source code for handling interrupt triggers for the LSM6DSL sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including setup, callback, and interrupt initialization functions.

methods.name: setup_irq
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for the sensor device, enabling or disabling it based on the 'enable' parameter.

methods.name: handle_irq
methods.description: Handles the interrupt by disabling further IRQs and signaling the appropriate thread or work to process the event.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets the trigger and handler for data-ready interrupts on the sensor device.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, calls handle_irq to process the event.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_thread_cb
methods.description: Callback function that executes the user-defined data ready handler and re-enables IRQs.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_thread
methods.description: Thread function that waits on a semaphore and processes IRQs in a dedicated thread context.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_work_cb
methods.description: Work handler for global thread configuration, calls thread callback.

methods.name: lsm6dsl_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO and interrupt configuration for the sensor device.
